_comment: Performance budgets (perf/README.md). bundles: true first-load JS per page in KB gz (layouts included, perf/lib/bundle-sizes.mjs); 150 is the playbook budget, a larger number is a documented exception (perf/REPORT.md) set just above today so it cannot grow. latency: warm p95 ms per perf/measure.mjs; defaults are the playbook budgets, routes{} are documented exceptions. ciScale multiplies latency limits when CI=true (GitHub runners are slower than the reference machine in perf/PROFILE.md).
